comment: Single shared source of truth for host-side endpoints used by the frozen runner, the S4 injectors and the fault-efficacy proof. The Kafka fault path is a group-member Toxiproxy proxy (127.0.0.1:19091); the former bootstrap-only alias on 19094 was removed after the runner switched every Kafka endpoint to a group member (A6/B7 follow-up). All ports bind loopback only.

kafka.fault_bootstrap_rule: fault_bootstrap MUST be one of group_member_proxies (a member of every Kafka proxy group) so the bootstrap connection itself is inside the injected toxic group; after metadata all broker connections follow the advertised 127.0.0.1:19091-19093 proxies anyway. Used by F3, F4a and K2 (M1-kafka) Kafka paths.
